item.title: Prominent Midwest auto dealer's Naples condo hits market for $15M
item.description: A beachfront condo in Naples, owned by a longtime prominent auto dealer from the Midwest who died of leukemia last month, has been listed for sale for just under $15 million. The condo is The Vanderbilt at Vanderbilt Beach, 9235 Gulf Shore Drive, Unit TL-2. The listing price is $14.99 million. The listing brokers, according to a statement, are Leah Ritchey and Amy Becker of Premier Sotheby’s International Realty’s Vanderbilt office. item.title: Naples club completes first phase of $16M renovation project
item.description: The Club at Olde Cypress in Naples has reopened its newly reimagined clubhouse following the completion of Phase I of a $16 million dollar renovation.The project is being overseen by the club’s owner, Stock Hospitality, part of the Stock Family of Cos. item.title: AdventHealth nearing completion of Pasco medical office building
item.description: AdventHealth is one step closer toward opening new medical offices on its Zephyrhills campus in Pasco County, according to a release. Officials signed the final construction beam for the 35,000-square-foot medical office building on Wednesday during a “topping out” ceremony held roughly six months after the project broke ground in late August. item.title: Nordstrom Rack sets Sarasota store opening date
item.description: An off-price retailer will open in the Sarasota Pavilion in mid-March. Nordstrom Rack has set its opening date for Thursday, March 19, at the shopping plaza at the corner of Stickney Point Road and US 41.The store will occupy 27,000 square feet in a spot that used to house Bed, Bath & Beyond. Nordstrom first announced its plans to locate there in 2024. item.description: The Tampa Bay Rays and the team’s new CEO are taking their sales pitch on the road.The team, which has been widely reported, looks to build a new stadium in Tampa and has identified the Dale Mabry campus of Hillsborough College as the right spot.
